title: Spring Tech Table
description: Kickoff of Tech Tables, conducting Tech Committee reflecting on the year so far, what is coming up in 2026, and open discussion on planning ahead. Wrap-up includes a one-hour happy hour to celebrate the release of the Planning with a Black Mirror card game. The American Planning Association's (APA) Technology Division created a scenario-based card game, to help planners collaboratively explore the impacts of emerging technologies and unpredictable events on communities. Please come expecting to learn and play with your fellow planners!.
location: VHB - One Penn Plaza, New York
